title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #066 · 팔레트 통일 [크림슨·검정·금] · 세로 띠·물결 · 4영역(에나멜 블록+호쿠사이+몬드리안+무하) · 풀커버 · towering hourglass · 왼 힙 팝 · Black · 배경 무도회장 · 메이크업 없음(블루블랙)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 20s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob auburn hair — her body is painted in 4 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Every style is rendered in one shared palette of crimson red, black and gold, so the whole figure reads as one harmonious composition. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 23% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 49% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 70% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries high-gloss enamel colour blocks with wet-looking highlights rendered only in crimson red, black and gold. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Hokusai Great Wave style rolling waves with foam claws and bold linework rendered only in crimson red, black and gold. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick lines and flat blocks rendered only in crimson red, black and gold. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries Mucha style Art Nouveau flowing floral curves rendered only in crimson red, black and gold. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, her legs fully in view — most extreme towering hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, bare natural brows and bare natural lips in her own deep tones, large eyes with bright real catchlights.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a bright grand ballroom with a polished parquet floor, tall mirrors, standard-height double doors and a low stage step, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
